name: @kickside/connection-ui
title: KickSide Connections
description: Connections management surface web component for kickside/connection.

wippy.description: Builds three web components served from /kickside-connections. The primary tag kickside-connections is the Connections management page (provider credentials and reply targets) the host nav mounts by tag; it takes no props, fetches its own data, and emits only the lifecycle events load, unload, error, and invalid. kickside-onboard-connections (entry onboard.js) is the onboarding-wizard variant of the same surface; it also takes no props and additionally emits done and back to drive the host wizard. kickside-connection-trait-picker (entry connection_trait_picker.js) is a capability config editor that picks one connection of a given provider: props are config (the current capability context, { connection_id }), provider (filters the offered connections; without it the picker renders a not-configured error), and label (field caption, defaults to "<provider> connection"), and every selection is reported via config-changed { connection_id }. The wippy.props block below describes only the primary kickside-connections tag (intentionally empty); per-tag props schemas live in the module registry's view.component entries.
